tasks.objective: Make LAZERS task submission durably idempotent using an explicit caller-supplied idempotency key: retrying the same key and validated task content in the same canonical repository returns the original task ID after a lost response or host restart, without creating duplicate tasks.

Implement one focused, live, read-only native Tasks side-panel increment for OpenCode Desktop over LAZERS' real immutable submitted records, following design/task-panel/tasks-focus-v2.png and interaction-spec.json. Share a canonical-project-scoped bounded query/detail service between GUI RPC and permission-checked Architect Code Mode tools, with post-commit change notifications and reliable resync. Enable evidence-based overlap investigation without implementing scheduling, execution, graphs, or task mutation; preserve the single GUI entry and concurrent WebGPU work.

Implement LAZERS' first usable XState-backed durable task runner: Architect submits a versioned dependency graph, deterministic runtime tooling admits and serially executes eligible tasks through real OpenCode workers in isolated worktrees, runs verification, persists outcomes/evidence, and delivers results or focused decision requests to the originating Architect. Recover recorded progress across process crashes without silently repeating uncertain side effects. Store graph relationships in the existing plugin-owned SQLite database, automatically audit readiness/overlap/session ownership, and expose real status, evidence, audit findings, and validated manual controls in the existing Tasks panel. This increment includes dependency graphs, not merely single-task plans; it excludes System Flow and Timeline.

Add the smallest usable Repomix-backed investigation increment to Architect in the existing LAZERS package: build and reuse a bounded index of the active worktree, retrieve focused original-source/test evidence, and optionally delegate bounded foreground questions to named read-only code-investigator and web-researcher subagents. Architect must establish repository facts before asking avoidable questions, retain material user-intent/authorization questions, and submit tasks with current source-grounded context. Research reports cite dated primary sources or state a precise capability failure. Inherit the current authorized subscription model unless explicitly configured otherwise; do not select a paid provider. Specify and verify this increment independently of durable runner task 94298112-1c6c-44ba-87f6-a06533eafa59.

Record and implement the user's clarified implementor boundary as a linked supplement to Repomix investigation task 313174d7-8358-4911-b006-1a1f25ca779c revision 1: the same bounded Repomix index/evidence service must supply focused, source-versioned ContextPacket material to implementors as well as Architect/research specialists. Register a reusable implementor role that inherits normal OpenCode/user/project capabilities, including available LSP/diagnostics, editing, shell and Code Mode, but cannot launch subagents. LAZERS owns implementation parallelism; runtime owns model/skill admission, write-scope enforcement, budgets, verification and acceptance. This is the supplemental context/role contract and tooling only, not implementation of durable runner 94298112-1c6c-44ba-87f6-a06533eafa59.

Harden the existing src/context Repomix service and reusable implementor context contribution.
